decisive_items: Perls Prussian blue staining showed prominent hemosiderin deposits
reddish-brown annular plaque with peripheral ecchymosis
response.rationale: Targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma uniquely matches the annular plaque with ecchymosis, hemosiderin deposits, and promontory signs; hobnail hemangioma shares cleftlike channels but lacks the targetoid clinical pattern and hemosiderin emphasis.

rejected.why: No pleomorphism or mitoses excludes angiosarcoma
No lymphedema history; rare and unsupported
Too nonspecific; lacks targetoid and hemosiderin features
Lacks targetoid clinical morphology and prominent hemosiderin deposits
